faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: In our FAQ section, you'll find clear answers to the most common questions about astano®, from product care and customization options to shipping, payment, and returns.

items.a: astano® specializes in high-quality kitchen gadgets, baking accessories, and custom-designed items. We offer both ready-made products and personalized solutions for hobby bakers and businesses.
Our products are carefully designed and manufactured from high-quality materials and meet strict quality standards. Many items are manufactured in Europe to ensure durability and precision.

items.q: How can I contact astano® to ask questions or get support?
items.a: You can reach us via the contact form on our website, by email, or by phone. Our customer service team will be happy to help you with any questions about products, orders, or custom designs.

items.q: How long does it take to receive my order?
items.a: Standard shipping within Germany usually takes 3–7 business days. International orders may take longer depending on the destination. Custom orders may require additional production time.
Yes! Once your order has been shipped, you will receive a tracking number by email, which you can use to track the delivery status.
Yes, astano® ships worldwide. Shipping costs and delivery times may vary depending on the destination.

items.q: Are astano® products safe to use?
items.a: Absolutely. We only use food-safe, high-quality materials such as stainless steel and approved plastics. All products undergo strict quality controls to ensure safety and durability.

items.q: Can I customize a cookie cutter or baking tool?
items.a: Yes! We offer custom designs, including logos, shapes, and sizes. Simply share your wishes with us and we will create a unique product that is tailored to your needs.

items.q: How do I care for my products?
items.a: Most of our products can be easily cleaned by hand or in the dishwasher. To ensure their longevity, we recommend washing stainless steel items by hand and drying them immediately to avoid water spots.

about.title: About Us – astano®
about.intro: As a family business with over 20 years of experience, we at astano® manufacture high-quality stainless steel and silicone products for the kitchen, table, and bar. With a passion for precision and individual design, we turn your ideas into reality – whether for everyday use, as a gift, or for your brand marketing.

craft.title: Carefully crafted – designed for everyday life
craft.body: At astano®, we combine decades of experience with a passion for sustainable, high-quality household goods. From stainless steel kitchen utensils to silicone accessories and versatile household items, our mission is to develop products that offer lasting value, safety, and timeless design.

quality.title: Committed to quality, inspired by everyday life
quality.body: At astano®, we believe that the small moments in life deserve extraordinary products. That's why we develop household and kitchen utensils that combine modern craftsmanship, durable materials, and thoughtful functionality. Each product is designed to make everyday life easier and more enjoyable and is particularly durable – so you can feel the difference every time you use it.

practical.title: Where craftsmanship meets practicality
practical.body: Our products are designed for everyday use, made from high-quality materials, and designed with great attention to detail – they combine style, durability, and customization in every single piece.

cards.title: Built to last. Designed to impress.
cards.body: Durability is our top priority when manufacturing our products. They are designed to withstand daily use while maintaining a high-quality appearance and feel.

cards.title: High-Quality Materials
cards.body: We only use high-quality materials to ensure peak performance and a finish that stands out from the rest.

cards.title: Every detail counts
cards.body: Durability is our top priority when manufacturing our products. They are designed to withstand daily use while maintaining a high-quality appearance and feel.

cards.title: Custom designs, specially designed for you
cards.body: Get a product that perfectly suits your needs. Each design is carefully tailored to your preferences and intended use.

quality.title: Quality at astano®
quality.intro: At astano®, quality is more than just a feature for us – it's a promise. Each of our products – from stainless steel cookie cutters to reusable straws, custom ice cube molds and baking utensils – meets the highest standards of durability, design and user-friendliness. We make every effort to deliver consistently excellent quality in every single product.

cards.title: Premium materials
cards.body: We use high-quality stainless steel, durable plastics or approved materials – selected for their durability, safety and performance. All products undergo strict quality controls to ensure that they meet or exceed our internal standards.

cards.title: Precision and consistency
cards.body: Regardless of whether you choose one of our 400 standard cookie cutters or commission a custom-designed cookie cutter with a logo engraving – our manufacturing process ensures that every product is manufactured with the highest precision and attention to detail.

cards.title: Functionality and user-friendliness
cards.body: Quality is not limited to appearance and technical data – it is reflected in everyday usability. The needs of the user are at the forefront of development: our baking utensils are designed to withstand frequent use, and our kitchen accessories are designed to be easy and safe to use.

steps.title: Material selection and testing
steps.body: Each raw material is tested for safety, durability and suitability. Only trusted suppliers pass our selection process.

steps.title: Final inspection and testing
steps.body: Before a product leaves our factory, it undergoes a rigorous inspection – including checks of structural integrity, surface quality and general usability.

steps.title: Customer feedback and evaluation
steps.body: We value your experience. Your feedback after purchase helps us identify potential for improvement so that we can adapt and develop further.

steps.title: Production monitoring
steps.body: Whether it is the production of standard articles or custom-designed individual pieces, we pay strict attention to compliance with specifications, tolerances and processing quality.

promise.title: Our promise to you
promise.body: When you choose astano®, you are not just buying a product – you are investing in reliability, craftsmanship and long-term satisfaction. We commit to ensuring these standards every day, with every tool, bowl and cutter we manufacture.

custom.title: Custom-Made Products
custom.intro: Turn your ideas into unique, high-quality creations. From custom cookie cutters to personalized baking utensils, astano® brings your designs to life with precision, premium materials, and fast turnaround.

lead.title: Bring your ideas to life with astano®
lead.body: At astano®, every great product starts with a great idea—yours. Whether you're a hobby baker, a brand, a bakery, or a business looking for custom shapes, logo cutters, or personalized kitchen tools, we'll turn your vision into a perfectly crafted, high-quality product.

steps.title: Share your idea
steps.body: Upload your sketch, logo, or reference image. Even a simple drawing is enough—we'll optimize it.

steps.title: Receive your design preview
steps.body: Our team turns your idea into a digital design for approval. You can request adjustments, shapes, or resizing.

steps.title: Delivery to your doorstep
steps.body: Your custom-made product is securely packaged and shipped to you.

cards.title: Precision-crafted designs
cards.body: From simple symbols to detailed logo shapes, we manufacture every cutter and tool with clean edges, precise lines, and consistent results.

cards.title: High-quality, food-safe materials
cards.body: All custom orders are made from high-quality stainless steel or certified food-safe materials—durable, safe, and designed for long-term use.

cards.title: Fast and hassle-free process
cards.body: Customization is easy with us. Share your idea, preview it, and we'll take care of production quickly and carefully.

cards.title: Perfect for businesses and special occasions
cards.body: Custom-designed products are ideal for bakeries, corporate branding, weddings, themed parties, product launches, and more.

shipping.title: Shipping
shipping.countries: We deliver within Germany and to the following countries: Austria, Belgium, Luxembourg, Latvia, Lithuania, Denmark, Sweden, Spain, France, Italy, Poland, Slovenia, Slovakia, Croatia, Hungary, Switzerland.
shipping.islands: Delivery to German and foreign islands is excluded.
shipping.domestic: We calculate shipping costs by shipping weight. Your individually calculated shipping costs are shown in the basket before you place your order.
shipping.abroad: We calculate shipping costs by shipping weight. Your individually calculated shipping costs are shown in the basket before you place your order.
shipping.carriers: Standard shipping is by parcel service. Bulky goods, and orders whose weight and volume are not suited to individual parcel shipping, are sent by freight forwarder on pallets. The shipping costs shown in the basket are always fixed. We choose the shipping route individually.

terms.title: Payment terms
terms.invoice: Payment by invoice is available from your second order onwards. Customers who have already paid by invoice on earlier orders are switched to invoice automatically, even where a first order would otherwise require prepayment.
terms.due: Where payment is by invoice, the invoice amount is due within 14 days. International orders and first orders are only possible by prepayment. Exceptions: regular customers and dealers who have also paid by invoice in the past.
terms.contact: If you have any questions, our contact details are in the imprint, or you can use our contact form.

times.title: Delivery & production times
times.custom: The great majority of our products are custom-made or finished to your specifications. For that reason we cannot state general production and delivery times covering every article here. You will find the delivery time for each product in the product description on the product page, under the "Additional information" tab.
times.standard: Standard transit times from dispatch are 2-3 working days within Germany (parcel) / 3-5 working days (freight), and 3-8 working days abroad (parcel) / 5-10 working days (freight).
